recommended_action: Immediately investigate the event_degradation scenario impacting Kafka and downstream consumers. Prioritize stabilising tool-executor (48.7% error rate, 241 tool failures) and api-gateway (62.4% error rate) as they represent the highest blast radius. Check postgres-auth connection pool saturation driving auth-service failures. Review LLM timeout thresholds to address the 25.7s p99 latency, and audit token budget settings to eliminate the 43 truncation events.
summary: A critical event_degradation fault injection is active, producing a 24.2% cluster-wide error rate and a severe p99 latency of ~25.8 seconds across 7,792 spans. The blast radius is broad: api-gateway (62.4%), tool-executor (48.7%), agent-service (36.6%), and payments-service (30.3%) are all experiencing major error spikes, with 241 GenAI tool failures and 43 token truncations further degrading AI-driven workflows.
